default.headline: Karim Haddad, Ledgerly founder; you last spoke about three weeks ago on WhatsApp.

points.text: Congrats on becoming Founder and CEO at Ledgerly.
He asked for an intro to Lina Chen and you have not replied yet.
Ledgerly is closing its seed round; a public note also covered the raise.
He said he is moving to Toronto in January.
